newsitem.title: ISRAEL: C&W seeks to raise Bezeq stake.
newsitem.headline: C&W seeks to raise Bezeq stake.

text.p: Britain's Cable & Wireless Plc has asked to increase its stake in Bezeq Israel Telecom to 21 percent, a senior official at Israel's Communications Ministry said on Monday.
"The request was made in a letter to the state-owned Corporations Authority," the official said.
C&W currently owns 10 percent of the government controlled phone monopoly. The ministry official said the request is being studied but no decision had yet been made.
C&W officials visited Israel last month to renew talks about their position in the company.
There has been opposition to allowing the British firm to increase its stake because this could hurt the government's attempt to eventually find a strategic partner for Bezeq.

The fear is that the Israeli government would be forced to accept C&W as that strategic partner as other telecommunications companies which have expressed interest would not want to invest. Among those that expressed interest in Bezeq are Southwestern Bell and American Telephone & Telegraph .
Last month Communications Minister Limor Livnat said she hoped to proceed with the global offering of 24 percent of Bezeq later this year.
